phenomenon: realistic-scale codebook, two constructions, both attested in only part of their grid
notes: Scaled and shaped after real extracted codebooks (median 38 entries): mostly standalone declarations with a minority of composed codes. The AGE x SEX grid has twelve cells and only seven are attested -- no HYF, SYF, SYU, ASYM or ASYU -- so recovering the classes requires generalizing across an incomplete rectangle rather than reading off a full paradigm. CONDITION+SCORE is a second, unrelated construction (neither class sequence is a subsequence of the other) and is itself gappy: fat0, fat1 and fat3 are attested, fat2 is not. Traps kept from the real data: four-letter species codes are conventional opaque labels despite being built from initials, and net-lane numerals are arbitrary lane identifiers rather than counts. Domain deliberately outside the device-repair setting the pipeline was developed on.

codebook.N1: net lane 1, the alder run below the shed
codebook.N2: net lane 2, along the cut hedgerow
codebook.N3: net lane 3, the wet corner by the culvert
codebook.N4: net lane 4, the upper field edge
codebook.N6: net lane 6, the fence line at the gate
codebook.fat0: fat score 0, no visible furcular fat
codebook.fat1: fat score 1, a trace of furcular fat
